# Instagram DM Bot

![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Archived-red?style=flat-square)
![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-v16.11+-green?style=flat-square)
![Puppeteer](https://img.shields.io/badge/Puppeteer-Automation-orange?style=flat-square)

> **Note:** Automated interaction with Instagram may violate their Terms of Service.

A Node.js application built with ``Puppeteer`` that automates sending Direct Messages to Instagram accounts via the Facebook Messenger interface. It is designed to simulate human-like behavior.

## **🚀 Features**

- **Web Scraping Automation:** Uses ``Puppeteer`` to interact with the web interface.
- **Human-Like Interaction:** Designed to run like a real user to avoid basic detection.
- **Bulk Messaging:** Send messages to a list of accounts automatically.
- **Customizable List:** Manage target accounts via a simple text file.

## **🛠 Installation**

1. **Clone the repository:**

   ``git clone https://github.com/mavi/instagram-dm-bot.git``

2. **Install dependencies:**

   ``npm install``

3. **Configuration:**

   - Open ``app.js`` and configure your settings between lines 10 and 13.
   - Add target Instagram usernames (without the "@" symbol) to ``accs-to-dm.txt``, one per line.

4. **Start the bot:**

   ``node app.js``

## **📂 Structure**

- ``app.js`` - Main application logic and Puppeteer configuration.
- ``accs-to-dm.txt`` - List of target Instagram accounts.
- ``.puppeteerrc.cjs`` - Puppeteer configuration file.
- ``package.json`` - Project dependencies and scripts.
